notes: Job CBPAUP0J step STEP01 (DFSRRC00 PARM='BMP,CBPAUP0C,PSBPAUTB'): IMS enters CBPAUP0C as a BMP, PROCEDURE DIVISION USING the I/O PCB and the one DB PCB of PSB PSBPAUTB (CMPAT=YES, PROCOPT=AP). It reads the PRM-INFO card from SYSIN (expiry 13 days, checkpoint frequency 00002 so CHKP fires, debug N; with 05 expiry days the first summary's DLET answers DJ and the step abends, RC 16, on both sides), walks the pending-authorization database DBPAUTP0 (HIDAM: PAUTSUM0 root, PAUTDTL1 child) with GN / GNP, deletes (DLET) each expired detail and each emptied summary, and takes basic checkpoints (CHKP ID). The database is the corpus's own HD unload (data/EBCDIC/AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.IMSDATA.DBPAUTP0.dat: 22 roots, 202 children), laid out by CIPAUSMY / CIPAUDTY; the step's DISPLAY output, RETURN-CODE and the database as the step leaves it are compared. The DL/I model is register family I (tests/equivalence/ims/ggdli.c, cobolrt/dli/DetDli.java), #5857.
